ai_summary: Adani Energy Solutions (AESL) has secured a significant Bihar transmission project through competitive bidding, projected to generate an annual tariff of approximately Rs 500 crore upon its commissioning by late 2028. This project materially expands AESL's portfolio by adding 881 circuit kilometers of transmission lines and 3,160 MVA of transformation capacity, bolstering the state's grid while specifically evacuating 2,400 MW from an upcoming Adani Power plant. While competitively bid, the notable aspect is the intra-group synergy for power evacuation.
